# Houseplant care

Open your reply with the line `Houseplant care:` and nothing else on it.

1. Name the plant the user means. If they did not say, ask which plant it is.
2. Give a watering routine for it: how to tell when it needs water, and roughly how often in summer and in winter.
3. Give a feeding routine: what kind of fertiliser, how diluted, and in which months.
4. Say when it will need repotting and how to tell: roots through the drainage holes, water running straight through.

Keep the reply short and practical.
